sam: Quick idea 1-min webinar: 'Mini Lab: Fast, Cheap, Reliable Demos' 1 practical knobs + a neat failover moment. Thoughts?

nora: love the bite-sized approach. good for folks who don't want a 60m deep-dive.

ben: if we keep it 15m make sure the demo is tightly scripted. learners should be able to copy 3 things.

riley: I can do the demo if we use a pinned image and 4 short prompts. available Jun 12-18 mornings PT.

sam: speaker split: intro + TL;DR playbook (sam), 3 rules + metrics (ben), demo + failover (riley). nora you host?

nora: yep happy to host and run a 30s poll: "Which constraint matters most? latency/cost/reliability".

ben: metrics we show: p50, p95, cost/1k, and a single slide showing improvement after batching+cache.

sam: run-of-show (tight):
```
00:00 - Welcome + outcomes (sam) 1m
01:00 - 3 rules + one slide of metrics (ben) 4m
05:00 - Poll (nora) 0.5m
05:30 - Live demo: baseline -> tune -> failover (riley) 8m
13:30 - Quick checklist share + CTA (sam) 1.5m
```

riley: will post 4 demo prompts and the container tag in a sec. need an IP allowlist for the live runner.

infra-bot: Staging reserved 2026-06-12 09:00 PT for 60m. Reminder set 24h prior.

ben: preflight checklist (mini): slides in drive, pinned image + sha, telemetry link, fallback routing ready, rehearsal video.

nora: rehearsals: tech dry run Jun 10 09:30 PT, full dress Jun 11 10:00 PT. confirm?

sam: confirm both. I'll draft registration copy and single CTA: 'Reserve your seat' + form field 'top constraint'.

riley: prompts posted to drive: https://rwd.infer/mini-lab-cases. will share image tag and whitelist today.

sam: great 1 thanks all. I'll send invites and the short gating checklist. :rocket:
